title: PARROT: An Open Multilingual Radiology Reports Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the linguistic diversity of the newly introduced PARROT dataset by quantifying the distribution of clinical reports across 13 different languages to evaluate its effectiveness in mitigating the English-centric (monolinguistic) bias prevalent in existing medical NLP datasets.

Analyzing and mapping the geographical distribution of the dataset's contributors across 21 countries and 4 continents to assess the representation of diverse regional reporting practices, conventions, and clinical terminologies.
